name: UK terrorism threat level
summary: UK national terrorism threat level Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely; no change found as of 13 Nov
state: The UK national terrorism threat level is Severe, meaning an attack is highly likely, after the Joint Terrorism Analysis Centre raised it from Substantial on 30 Apr 2026 (MI5). Counter Terrorism Policing issued a statement on the change at the time. Searches on 13 Nov found no announced change to the level.
for_you: The level reflects the assessed likelihood of an attack, not a specific threat. MI5 and Counter Terrorism Policing advise the public to stay alert and report suspicious activity; ACT and gov.uk publish guidance on what to do.
